subject: Error in .Call("FreeADFunObject", ptr, PACKAGE = DLL) :   "FreeADFunObject" not available for .Call() for package

messages.author: df65534f41c91ca2
messages.subject: Error in .Call("FreeADFunObject", ptr, PACKAGE = DLL) :   "FreeADFunObject" not available for .Call() for package
parts:
Hello,
I have only recently encountered this error when running code that used to be error-free:

Error in .Call("FreeADFunObject", ptr, PACKAGE = DLL) :
  "FreeADFunObject" not available for .Call() for package "[my file]"

I have seen in other forums [1,2] this problem when using glmmTMB. However, I don't even have glmmTMB installed; I am only using TMB 1.7.18 in R 3.6.3 (as I used to before encountering this error).

Although the error seems important, TMB does give results for the inference. Any help is appreciated!

messages.subject: Re: [TMB users] Error in .Call("FreeADFunObject", ptr, PACKAGE = DLL) : "FreeADFunObject" not available for .Call() for package
parts:
My first guess would be to try this:

install.packages("TMB", type="source")
Give that a try and let the list know if the problem persists.

cheers,
Mollie
